name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Three additions, no forced item recreation this time (existing watch progress and ids are untouched): (1) Duplicate detection against locally-owned content now checks the whole server, not just the federated library's own folder - a movie you already own in a separate, ordinary library now correctly blocks its federated duplicate from being created. (2) A small icon now appears next to federated items' titles in jellyfin-web (grid cards, lists, and the detail page), so it's clear at a glance which items are streamed from another server - implemented by injecting a small script into index.html at server startup, the same technique other Jellyfin plugins use for client-side additions. (3) Investigated why federated items never showed up in Continue Watching: they already have everything Jellyfin's resume logic needs (stable id, RunTimeTicks, IsVirtualItem=false) - the real cause was that every forced-recreation migration through 0.0.31 wiped saved watch position along with the item it recreated. 0.0.31 was the last of those; resume should now accumulate and persist normally going forward.
